description: This file contains server-side logic for the TheorySet webpage of an Online Examination System. It manages course selection, question addition, exam setup, and user interface navigation actions, including database interactions for storing questions and course details.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for the TheorySet ASP.NET page, handling course selection, question management, and navigation within the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented-out code related to session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin panel when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin queue page on button click.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database and updates question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam for the selected course by inserting details into the database.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to question and mark entries.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Automatically updates question number based on selected course.
